mosquito.en: He'd tramp through mosquito infested jungles with bundles of maps and a theodolite, a type of instrument used for surveying territory and measuring angles.
mosquito.zh: 他会背着一捆捆地图和经纬仪——一种用于勘测地形和测量角度的仪器，跋涉在蚊虫肆虐的丛林中。

mosquito.en: What about you? Well, recently I was bitten by a mosquito and, as you know, when you get bitten by a mosquito, it's really itchy.
mosquito.zh: 你呢？我最近被蚊子咬了，你知道的，被蚊子咬了之后真的特别痒。

mosquito.en: What about you? Well, recently I was bitten by a mosquito and, as you know, when you get bitten by a mosquito, it's really itchy.
mosquito.zh: 你呢？我最近被蚊子咬了，你知道的，被蚊子咬了之后真的特别痒。

mostly.en: I mentioned that Britain imports 40% of its food from other producers, mostly in Europe.
mostly.zh: 我提到过英国 40% 的食物是从其他生产国进口的，其中大部分在欧洲。

mostly.en: Echo chambers are spaces where people mostly see content they already agree with.
mostly.zh: 回音室是指人们主要看到自己已经认同的内容的空间。

mostly.en: The population there was still mostly French-speaking, especially along the Saint Lawrence River.
mostly.zh: 那里的人口仍然主要说法语，尤其是在圣劳伦斯河沿岸。

mostly.en: And she found a very clear pattern. During the day, conversations were mostly practical.
mostly.zh: 她发现了一个非常清晰的模式。白天，对话大多是实用的。

mostly.en: As you might imagine, I get tonnes of emails, mostly from non-native speakers.
mostly.zh: 正如你所想象的，我收到了大量的电子邮件，大多数来自非母语者。

monitor.en: Crowd movement in busy places can be monitored, and alerts can be quickly sent.
monitor.zh: 可以监视繁忙地点的密集人群移动，并迅速发送警报。

monitor.en: In a surveillance society, monitoring is not limited to one place or one moment.
monitor.zh: 在一个监控社会中，监视并不局限于一个地方或一个时刻。

monitor.en: For one thing, how can you monitor clouds which are constantly moving and changing?
monitor.zh: 一方面，你怎么能监测那些不断移动和变化的云呢？

monitor.en: So, climate models monitor clouds to accurately measure how much the Earth is out of whack.
monitor.zh: 因此，气候模型监测云层，以准确测量地球失衡的程度。

monitor.en: And also reptiles like the Megalania, which was a monitor lizard the size of a house.
monitor.zh: 甚至还有像古巨蜥这样的爬行动物，它是一种体型堪比房屋的巨蜥。

mood.en: This word attempts to capture the mood, trends and changes in our society.
mood.zh: 这个词试图捕捉我们社会的士气、趋势和变化。

mood.en: It depends on many things, including their day, the weather and their mood.
mood.zh: 这取决于很多事情，包括他们的日程、天气和心情。

mood.en: A person's mood is the way they are feeling at a particular time.
mood.zh: 一个人的心情是他们在特定时间的感觉。

mood.en: The whole shebang. And it's a similar change of mood in the US, in Japan, the world over.
mood.zh: 样样俱全。在美国、日本以及全世界，人们的态度也都发生了类似的转变。

mood.en: Hardly surprising, perhaps. Another tracked changes in national mood based on how cheerful or gloomy song lyrics became over the course of decades.
mood.zh: 这或许并不令人意外。另一项研究则根据几十年间歌曲歌词变得欢快还是沮丧，来追踪国家情绪的变化。

moral.en: Whitehouse was a campaigner for what she called moral standards in public life.
moral.zh: Whitehouse 是一位致力于她所谓的公共生活道德标准的活动家。

moral.en: He was an ordinary bureaucrat who had given up moral responsibility and simply done his job.
moral.zh: 他只是一个放弃了道德责任、单纯完成本职工作的普通官僚。

moral.en: She had spent years challenging what she saw as the moral decline of British television and publishing.
moral.zh: 她花费数年时间挑战她眼中英国电视和出版业的道德沦丧。

moral.en: One is the Instructions of Shuruppak, which is an ancient Sumerian text, and it contains advice and moral guidance.
moral.zh: 一个是《舒如帕克箴言》（Instructions of Shuruppak），这是一部古苏美尔文本，包含建议和道德指导。

moral.en: Clear moral lines. The good man with the gun.
moral.zh: 善恶分明，手持枪械的正义之人。

mouse.en: The adjective squeaky describes things which make a high-pitched sound like a mouse.
mouse.zh: 形容词“吱吱叫的”（squeaky）形容发出像老鼠一样高音的事物。

mouse.en: But there was nothing there. It wasn’t mice, it wasn’t some pest, or bed bugs.
mouse.zh: 但周围什么也没有。不是老鼠，不是什么害虫，也不是臭虫。

mouse.en: Or if you work from home, constantly move your computer mouse around, so your online status says “Active”.
mouse.zh: 或者如果你在家办公，就不断地晃动电脑鼠标，这样你的在线状态就会显示为“在线”。

modify.en: The drugs are modified versions of natural hormones which make us feel full when released into the body.
modify.zh: 这些药物是天然激素的改良版本，天然激素在释放到体内时会让我们产生饱腹感。

modify.en: It has been replicated many times since, in modified and more ethically cautious forms, and the core finding has proved remarkably robust.
modify.zh: 此后它被多次以修改过的、在伦理上更谨慎的形式重复验证，而其核心结论也被证明相当稳健可靠。

mount.en: Was it: a) the Arctic, b) Antarctica, or c) the top of Mount Everest?
mount.zh: 是：a) 北极，b) 南极，还是 c) 珠穆朗玛峰顶？

mount.en: With mounting evidence, the FBI obtained a search warrant for Ted Kaczynski's cabin in Montana.
mount.zh: 随着证据越来越多，FBI 获得了搜查泰德·卡钦斯基在蒙大拿州木屋的搜查令。

mount.en: But compared to getting to the top of Mount Everest, getting to the bottom of the Mariana Trench is a lot harder.
mount.zh: 但与登上珠穆朗玛峰的山顶相比，到达马里亚纳海沟的底部要困难得多。

mount.en: Of course, this is politics, so they’ll choose this strategically based on alliances, rewarding supporters, punishing critics, and perhaps putting rivals in token positions of responsibility from where they cannot mount an attack.
mount.zh: 当然，这是政治，所以他们会根据联盟、奖赏支持者、惩罚批评者，以及可能把竞争对手安排在没有实权但负有象征责任的职位上以防他们发起攻击，来战略性地做出选择。

mount.en: And just as standing on the top of the world, and summiting Mount Everest has become a goal for the world’s most adventurous explorers, so has going to the very depths of the Mariana Trench.
mount.zh: 正如站在世界之巅、登顶珠穆朗玛峰已成为世界上最具冒险精神的探险家的目标一样，前往马里亚纳海沟的最深处也是如此。

movement.en: Crowd movement in busy places can be monitored, and alerts can be quickly sent.
movement.zh: 可以监视繁忙地点的密集人群移动，并迅速发送警报。

movement.en: If we look back, major social movements often begin during periods of longterm pressure.
movement.zh: 如果我们回顾过去，大型社会运动往往在长期压力的时期开始。

movement.en: This uprising was organized mainly by the Polish resistance movement, known as the Home Army.
movement.zh: 这场起义主要是由被称为“家乡军”的波兰抵抗运动组织起来的。

movement.en: Most people in Overseas France consider themselves French, but there are significant independence movements.
movement.zh: 外海法国的大多数人认为自己是法国人，但也有重大的独立运动。

movement.en: Here, Marie Derome explains the meaning of these movements to BBC Radio 4 programme, Woman's Hour.
movement.zh: 在这里，玛丽·德罗姆向BBC广播四台的节目《女性时间》解释了这些动作的含义。

mobile.en: Marie developed mobile X-ray units, which became known as “Little Curies “.
mobile.zh: 玛丽开发了移动式 X 射线车，被称为“小居里”（Little Curies）。

mobile.en: They made humans more effective, more mobile, and more secure.
mobile.zh: 它们让人类变得更高效、更具机动性、也更安全。

mobile.en: The Iberians, from what is now Spain, were fierce and mobile, and were especially suited to mountainous terrain.
mobile.zh: 来自今西班牙的伊比利亚人凶猛且机动性强，特别适合山地作战。

mobile.en: By the end of the war, it is estimated that Curie’s mobile units had treated hundreds of thousands of injured soldiers.
mobile.zh: 到战争结束时，据估计居里夫人的移动医疗车已经治疗了数十万名受伤士兵。

mobile.en: Britain has traditionally had a stronger class system, so it’s been viewed as less socially mobile than the United States.
mobile.zh: 英国传统上拥有更森严的阶级制度，因此其社会流动性一直被认为不如美国。

motion.en: Isaac Newton's theories of motion and gravitation were ten years old.
motion.zh: 艾萨克的运动和万有引力理论已经问世十年。

motion.en: Social media has changed fast and is still in motion.
motion.zh: 社交媒体变化很快，而且仍在变动中。

motion.en: While not everyone accepted evolution immediately, Darwin had set in motion a shift, a change, in how humans understand life.
motion.zh: 虽然并非每个人都立刻接受了进化论，但Darwin已经引发了一场变革——人类理解生命方式的转变。

motion.en: Emma and James set up their equipment to monitor and record ground motion as the concert got started, as James explains here to Marnie Chesterton, presenter of BBC Radio 4 programme, 'Inside Science': Tell me about the peak on this graph that you're seeing, and what that actually corresponds to.
motion.zh: Emma和James设置了他们的设备来监测和记录演唱会开始时的地面运动，正如James在这里向BBC Radio 4节目《走近科学》的主持人Marnie Chesterton所解释的那样：告诉我你在这个图表上看到的峰值，以及这究竟对应着什么。

motion.en: Again, we’ll talk more about this in part three, and look at how the situation in France is very different to the situation in several other European countries, but the point to remember is that the 1973 oil crisis shook the French so much that it set the wheels in motion for the energy security that France enjoys today.
motion.zh: 同样，我们会在第三集中详细讨论这一点，并看看法国的情况与欧洲其他几个国家的情况有何不同，但需要记住的一点是，1973年的石油危机给法国人带来了巨大的震动，为法国今天享有的能源安全奠定了基础。

monster.en: A huge maze built under the city. Inside the maze lived a terrifying monster.
monster.zh: 一个建在城市下面的巨大迷宫。迷宫里住着一个可怕的怪物。

monster.en: Can otherwise normal, rational people, be turned into monsters, if placed in particular circumstances?
monster.zh: 原本正常、理性的人，如果被置于特定的环境中，会不会变成怪物？

monster.en: A man who loved clocks. Not the monster he is sometimes portrayed as.
monster.zh: 一个热爱时钟的男人。而不是有时被描绘成的那种怪物。

monster.en: Her argument was that Eichmann was not a monster in the traditional sense.
monster.zh: 她的论点是，艾希曼并不是传统意义上的那种“怪物”。

monster.en: In practically every culture with some history of seafaring, there are stories of mysterious sea monsters, beasts from the deep.
monster.zh: 在几乎所有拥有航海历史的文化中，都有关于神秘海怪和深渊野兽的故事。

molecule.en: When we breathe in, receptor cells in the nose detect molecules in the air and send them to olfactory organs in the brain.
molecule.zh: 当我们吸气时，鼻子里的受体细胞探测到空气中的分子，并将它们发送到大脑的嗅觉器官。

molecule.en: These molecules can be incredibly expensive to develop, and some take years of research before they’re ready to be used in a commercial fragrance.
molecule.zh: 开发这些分子可能成本极高，有些甚至需要多年的研究才能准备好用于商业香水。

molecule.en: From the ancient temples of Mesopotamia to the laboratories of modern perfumers, from the rarest natural ingredients to the synthetic molecules designed to mimic them, perfume is much more than just a pleasant smell.
molecule.zh: 从美索不达米亚的古代神庙到现代调香师的实验室，从最稀有的天然成分到旨在模仿它们的合成分子，香水远不止是一种令人愉悦的气味。

moderate.en: Earlier in his career, he was associated with Labour’s more moderate or center-right side.
moderate.zh: 在他职业生涯的早期，他曾与工党偏温和或中右翼的一派联系紧密。

moderate.en: Soilih has ideas. Very radical ideas, and no interest in sharing power with Jaffar, whom he considers too moderate, too willing to appease France.
moderate.zh: Ali Soilih 很有想法。非常激进的想法，而且他根本不想与 Said Mohamed Jaffar 共享权力，因为他认为后者太温和，太急于向法国妥协。

moderate.en: Mild or moderate acne is very common in teenagers and younger adults, so according to the UK’s National Health Service, what proportion of people aged 11 to 30 experience some amount of acne?
moderate.zh: 轻度或中度痤疮在青少年和年轻成年人中非常普遍，那么根据英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的数据，11岁到30岁的人群中有多少比例经历过某种程度的痤疮？

moderate.en: The labels above the switches ranged from "Slight Shock" through to "Moderate Shock," "Strong Shock," "Very Strong Shock," "Intense Shock," and "Extreme Intensity Shock," to a final cluster of three switches simply labelled "XXX."
moderate.zh: 开关上方的标签从“轻微电击”(Slight Shock)一路排到“中度电击”“强烈电击”“非常强烈电击”“剧烈电击”“极端强度电击”，最后三个开关干脆只标着“XXX”。

moderate.en: It was a moderate success. It never made much money, but it did teach the then 26-year-old some boring but important skills: things like inventory management, pricing, customer service, and the basics of running an online business.
moderate.zh: 这算得上是小有成功。它虽然没赚到什么大钱，但确实让当时 26 岁的他学到了一些枯燥却重要的技能：比如库存管理、定价、客户服务以及运营在线业务的基本知识。

mock.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
mock.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

mock.en: Hardy filled with new mathematical results, including those mysterious mock theta functions.
mock.zh: Hardy信中充满了新的数学结果，包括那些神秘的仿θ函数。

mock.en: Perhaps the most mysterious of his discoveries were his mock theta functions, which he discovered near the end of his life.
mock.zh: 也许他最神秘的发现是他在生命接近尾声时发现的仿θ函数（mock theta functions）。

mock.en: He had become a kind of national symbol of British misrule: the small voice that mocks authority, breaks the rules, and gets away with it.
mock.zh: 他已经成为英国无政府状态的一种国家象征：那个嘲笑权威、打破规则却又能逍遥法外的微小声音。

mock.en: After this mock arrest process, the prisoners were blindfolded and transported to the basement of Stanford University’s psychology building, which had been transformed into a makeshift prison.
mock.zh: 经过这场模拟逮捕后，囚犯们被蒙上眼睛，送往斯坦福大学心理学系大楼的地下室——那里已经被改造成一座临时监狱。

monarch.en: But, and this is an important but, the monarch will never go against Parliament.
monarch.zh: 但是，这是一个重要的“但是”，君主绝不会与议会作对。

monarch.en: This made him the King’s official gatekeeper, controlling all access to the monarch.
monarch.zh: 这使他成为了国王的官方守门人，控制着所有人面见君主的渠道。

monarch.en: He was now not just the president, but something closer to a monarch.
monarch.zh: 他现在不仅是总统，更接近于一个君王。

monarch.en: So it is essentially ceremonial, although officially the monarch could say no.
monarch.zh: 所以它本质上是象征性的，尽管官方上君主可以说不。

monarch.en: Like the British monarch, Canada’s monarch is almost entirely a ceremonial figure.
monarch.zh: 和英国君主一样，加拿大的君主几乎完全是一个象征性的虚位元首。

morality.en: The law itself was intertwined with Christian assumptions about morality and order.
morality.zh: 法律本身与关于道德和秩序的基督教假设交织在一起。

morality.en: Human behaviour is complex, and the experiment doesn’t account for other factors like personality, individual morality, or personal choice.
morality.zh: 人类行为是复杂的，而这场实验并没有考虑到其他因素，比如个性、个人道德或个人选择。

morality.en: Now, before we get into any discussion of the morality of this, it was clearly a very good business: in the United States alone, there are 37 million active illegal drug users.
morality.zh: 在我们讨论这件事情的道德性之前，这显然是一门非常好的生意：光是在美国，就有 3700 万活跃的非法吸毒者。

monopoly.en: His company had a monopoly over the workers and over the island.
monopoly.zh: 他的公司对工人和整个岛屿拥有垄断权。

monopoly.en: The regime maintains control through an almost total monopoly on information.
monopoly.zh: 这个政权靠着对信息近乎完全的垄断来维持统治。

monopoly.en: Brazil’s ports were also opened to friendly foreign nations for the first time, which ended Portugal’s monopoly over the colonial trade.
monopoly.zh: 巴西的港口也首次对友好的外国开放，这结束了葡萄牙对殖民贸易的垄断。

mode.en: And “goblin mode” describes a kind of lazy, messy, and unapologetically unbothered attitude.
mode.zh: 而“goblin mode”描述的是一种懒散、邋遢、毫不在意别人看法、理直气壮不上进的态度。

mode.en: In 2022, Oxford let the public vote on the word of the year, and the winner was “goblin mode”.
mode.zh: 2022 年，牛津词典把年度词汇的决定权交给公众投票，最终胜出的是“goblin mode”(哥布林模式)。

mode.en: Most of the big AI companies will have a “voice mode”, so just open that up and start talking.
mode.zh: 大多数大型人工智能公司都有“语音模式”，所以只需打开它并开始说话即可。

mode.en: Most of the AI tools, from ChatGPT to Gemini, they have a voice mode, where you can have a conversation about whatever you want.
mode.zh: 大多数人工智能工具，从 ChatGPT 到 Gemini，都有语音模式，你可以在其中就任何你想要的话题进行对话。

mortal.en: Odysseus does finally return home, but he must do so in secret, fearful that revealing his identity too soon would put him in mortal danger.
mortal.zh: 奥德修斯最终确实回到了家，但他必须秘密行事，因为他担心过早暴露身份会让自己陷入致命的危险之中。

mourn.en: There was no state funeral, no national mourning.
mourn.zh: 没有国葬，也没有全国哀悼。

mourn.en: They were mourned when they died. But the Victorians didn't just move dogs into the living room; they fundamentally redesigned them.
mourn.zh: 它们死后会被人哀悼。但维多利亚时代的人不仅把狗请进了起居室，他们还从根本上重新设计了狗。

mortgage.en: Basically, the banks were giving people mortgages, loans, who couldn’t afford those loans.
mortgage.zh: 基本上，银行在向那些根本买不起房的人发放抵押贷款。

mortgage.en: Banks offered subprime mortgages, which were loans given to people with low or risky credit scores.
mortgage.zh: 银行提供次级抵押贷款，即向信用评分低或有风险的人发放贷款。

mortgage.en: One employee at a bank accepting bribes in return for giving out mortgages, that is individual corruption.
mortgage.zh: 银行的一名员工在发放抵押贷款时接受贿赂，这就是个体腐败。

mortgage.en: Maybe they have a mortgage, maybe they finance their car, they have to pay back their graduate school every month.
mortgage.zh: 也许他们有房贷，也许他们贷款买车，他们每个月必须偿还研究生院的贷款。

mortgage.en: The GI Bill allowed veterans, former soldiers, to attend university for free or buy homes with cheap mortgages.
mortgage.zh: 《退伍军人权利法案》允许退伍老兵（即前士兵）免费上大学或通过低息抵押贷款买房。

motive.en: No motive. No pattern they could reliably identify.
motive.zh: 没有动机。没有他们能可靠识别的模式。

motive.en: There is a photograph of him strolling around London with a well-known Czech spy, and there is the testimony of a high-ranking Czech spy, who had no discernible motive to lie.
motive.zh: 有一张他与一名著名的捷克间谍在伦敦散步的照片，还有一名捷克高级间谍的证词，而那个人并没有明显的撒谎动机。

monk.en: To manage its sprawling empire it needed more than just monks who could pray and copy manuscripts.
monk.zh: 为了管理其庞大的帝国的需要，它需要的不仅仅是会祈祷和抄写手稿的修士。

monk.en: Monks were practically the only group in society that could read and write; books had to be meticulously copied by hand, by monks, of course, and these sources of knowledge were kept in monasteries, often under lock and key.
monk.zh: 修士几乎是社会中唯一能够读写的人；书籍必须由修士一笔一划地精心抄写，当然，这些知识的来源被保存在修道院里，通常是锁在柜子里的。

mountainous.en: All of them came from the snowy and mountainous regions of Japan.
mountainous.zh: 他们全都来自日本多雪和多山的地区。

mountainous.en: The Iberians, from what is now Spain, were fierce and mobile, and were especially suited to mountainous terrain.
mountainous.zh: 来自今西班牙的伊比利亚人凶猛且机动性强，特别适合山地作战。

mosque.en: And other books are spread religiously, maybe through churches or mosques, and maybe were not sold.
mosque.zh: 还有些书籍是通过宗教途径传播的，也许是通过教堂或清真寺，而且可能并不是拿来卖的。

mosque.en: Christian churches were converted into mosques, including the Hagia Sophia, and magnificent new structures were built.
mosque.zh: 基督教教堂被改建为清真寺，包括圣索菲亚大教堂，并且建造了宏伟的新建筑。

mosque.en: Two of the most famous are the Topkapi Palace, the home of the sultans, and later the Blue Mosque.
mosque.zh: 其中最著名的两座是苏丹住所托普卡帕宫，以及后来的蓝色清真寺。

mosque.en: It was founded in 1928, and had grown into Egypt’s largest and best-organised Islamist movement, preaching social justice through a large network of charities, schools, and mosques.
mosque.zh: 它成立于 1928 年，已发展成为埃及最大、组织最严密的伊斯兰运动，通过庞大的慈善机构、学校和清真寺网络宣扬社会正义。

mobility.en: There are also systems in the US designed to create social mobility.
mobility.zh: 美国也有旨在创造社会流动性的体制。

mobility.en: Many researchers also argue that social mobility has slowed down.
mobility.zh: 许多研究人员还认为，社会流动性已经放缓。

mobility.en: The Arab forces had the advantage of mobility, knowledge of the terrain, and motivation, but they lacked the heavy weaponry, discipline, and resources of the Ottoman army.
mobility.zh: 阿拉伯军队拥有机动性、地形知识和动力等优势，但缺乏奥斯曼军队那样的重型武器、纪律和资源。

mould.en: Take, for example, oud, which is a resin produced by a particular type of tree when it becomes infected with mould.
mould.zh: 以沉香（oud）为例，它是一种特定类型的树木在被霉菌感染时产生的树脂。

modest.en: In 1996, Vladimir Putin moved to Moscow, leaving behind his relatively modest role in St.
modest.zh: 1996年，Vladimir Putin搬到了莫斯科，告别了他在圣彼得堡相对低调的角色。

modest.en: For much of its early history, Rio de Janeiro was a relatively modest colonial town.
modest.zh: 在其早期历史的大部分时间里，里约热内卢只是一个相对较小的殖民城镇。

modest.en: But for a long time, Warsaw was just a modest community of fishermen and traders living behind the Vistula River.
modest.zh: 但在很长一段时间里，华沙只是维斯瓦河畔一个简朴的渔民和商人社区。

modest.en: In terms of his parents, he came from a modest background; his father was a customs officer, and his mother was a devout Muslim.
modest.zh: 至于他的父母，他出身于一个普通家庭；他的父亲是一名海关官员，母亲是一位虔诚的穆斯林。

modest.en: It was not yet a capital and there was little to suggest that these small, modest trading towns would one day stand at the center of German and world history.
modest.zh: 它还不是首都，几乎没有迹象表明这些小而简朴的贸易小镇有一天会站在德国和世界历史的中心。

momentum.en: The momentum behind nuclear power had started to shift.
momentum.zh: 核电发展背后的势头开始发生转变。

momentum.en: But small steps can help you build momentum.
momentum.zh: 但小步骤可以帮你建立势头。

monetary.en: And with this very real monetary incentive, diving bell technology did increase dramatically, and divers were able to go down to depths of twenty or so metres and stay there for extended periods of time, supported either by tubes or sealed buckets of fresh air delivered from the surface.
monetary.zh: 随着这种非常现实的金钱激励，潜水钟技术有了显著的提高，潜水员能够下潜到二十米左右的深度并在那里停留很长时间，由从水面输送的管道或密封的新鲜空气桶提供支持。

motivate.en: Tracking keeps you honest and it keeps you motivated.
motivate.zh: 记录能让你对自我保持诚实，并保持动力。

motivate.en: I end up buying a lot of textbooks with the hope they’re going to motivate me, and then not really using them.
motivate.zh: 我结果买了一大堆教材，希望它们能激励我，然后却并不怎么用它们。

motivate.en: For some people, English exams provide a clear goal to motivate your study and offer a fair way to measure language ability.
motivate.zh: 对某些人来说，英语考试提供了一个明确的目标来激励学习，并提供了一种公平衡量语言能力的方法。

motivate.en: Hopefully one or two of these resolutions will fit into your situation and motivate you to make your own goals for next year.​
motivate.zh: 希望其中一两个决心能契合你的现状，并激励你为明年制定自己的目标。

monument.en: Some countries launched major advertising campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their national monument.
monument.zh: 一些国家发起大型广告活动，鼓励公民为本国古迹投票。

monument.en: A monument’s importance does not increase because millions of people vote for it online.
monument.zh: 一座纪念碑的重要性并不会因为数百万人在线投票而增加。

monument.en: The Moai are one of the most recognizable monuments in the world.
monument.zh: Moai 是世界上辨识度最高的纪念碑之一。

moreover.en: Moreover, Istanbul is located in an area at risk of earthquakes.
moreover.zh: 此外，伊斯坦布尔位于地震多发区。
